subject: GGPay compliance playbook, mop‑up items and owners
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ggpay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: security@ggpay.com, procurement@ggpay.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's compliance call

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and the items we'd like Redwood to confirm so we can move through procurement: 

- Pain points we discussed: audit log retention policy (we require 1 year immutable audit logs for production), proof of SOC 2 controls mapped to data exfil prevention, and clear DPA language for limited processing and subprocessor list.
- Pen test: internal team will want a scope and preferred window; ideally we'd see a vendor attestation or the SR/PO planning window first.
- Data locality: our EU customers require that EU tenant data be stored in EU regions (where applicable).

Can you confirm: 1) whether you can provide a SOC 2 Type II report and the set of artifacts you typically share; 2) options for audit log retention and export; 3) a draft DPA/redline path.

I've attached our DDQ export (GGPay_DDQ_20270609.pdf) for reference. Procurement will expect a short delivery timeline once we have the SOC 2 and the log/export answers.

Appreciate a short action plan and owners.

Best,
Sarah Lim
Head of Security Programs
GGPay

Attachment: GGPay_DDQ_20270609.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ggpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up from today's compliance call

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear summary and for sending the DDQ. Short answers up front, followed by an action plan and owners.

Quick confirmations:
- SOC 2: Redwood can provide a SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary). We also maintain a controls mapping (we'll attach a one‑pager).
- Audit logs: we support configurable retention; standard hosted tier includes 90 days, Dedicated/Private can be configured to 12 months immutable retention (we'll provide export and SIEM ingestion guidance).
- DPA & data locality: we have a standard DPA that supports EU region controls and can add data locality language for EU‑tenant separation. Legal reviews redlines through DocuSign if that works.
- Pen test: we can provide a vendor attestation and coordinate a 3‑5 day pen test window — recommended window: Jun 28 — Jul 2.

Proposed owners and next steps:
1) SOC 2 artifact package (Ben) — deliver redacted SOC 2 Type II and 1‑page control map by Fri 2027‑06‑11.
2) Audit log options (Monica) — provide retention options, export format (JSON/CSV), and SIEM ingestion doc by Mon 2027‑06‑14.
3) DPA redlines (Evelyn & Legal) — share Redwood standard DPA and DocuSign link; review timeline: 3 business days for first pass.
4) Pen test coordination (Ben & GGPay security) — confirm scope & preferred vendor; target window Jun 28 — Jul 2.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary of controls) and a Drive link to the compliance playbook.

If that timeline looks good, I'll open the HubSpot deal tasks and cc procurement to keep the rhythm.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GGpay-onboard-plan
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: GGPay — artifact list, retention options, and legal path (please action)

Ben/Monica — following up from my reply to Sarah. I've pasted the high‑level ask below for context. Please see owners above; I need quick confirmation that you can hit these dates.

Quoted for context:
> "SOC 2: Redwood can provide a SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary). We also maintain a controls mapping.
> Audit logs: support configurable retention; standard hosted tier includes 90 days, Dedicated/Private can be configured to 12 months immutable retention (we'll provide export and SIEM ingestion guidance).
> DPA & data locality: standard DPA supports EU region controls and can add data locality language.
> Pen test: provide vendor attestation and coordinate a 3‑5 day pen test window — recommended Jun 28 — Jul 2."

Action items (short):
- Ben: please prepare the redacted SOC 2 PDF (type II) and a 1‑page controls mapping that ties controls to GGPay DDQ sections. Deadline: EOD Fri 2027‑06‑11. If there are any gaps we should flag them now (e.g., if we can't share raw logs), call it out.
- Monica: produce a short doc with the retention options for hosted vs Dedicated vs Private, include the export format (sample JSON schema) and SIEM ingestion example. Deadline: Mon 2027‑06‑14. Also include estimated costs for 12‑month immutable retention in Dedicated.
- Legal sync: I'll loop legal if procurement pushes DPA redlines; flag any clauses that routinely get pushed back.

Attach anything to the HubSpot deal (link below) and I'll forward to Sarah. If you can't meet dates, propose alternatives now so I can reset expectations.

Thanks —
Evelyn

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@ggpay.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: security@ggpay.com, procurement@ggpay.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up from today's compliance call

Evelyn —

This looks good, thank you. Procurement will circulate a DPA redline via DocuSign by EOD tomorrow; we'll target first pass comments back by Tue 2027‑06‑15.

Two quick asks to include in the artifact package:
- A list of log fields/export sample (we need obvious fields: timestamp, request_id, user_id, model_id, region, event_type).
- A statement on key rotation cadence and HSM/KMS use for customer keys (if any are customer‑managed).

Pen test: we'll plan the internal calendar against Jun 28 — Jul 2 and will share the vendor contact if we use our preferred assessor.

I'll review the SOC 2 and redwood doc when you send. Appreciate the owners and timeline — procurement will track.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Security Programs
GGPay

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/ GGPay will send DPA redline
